mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO notification_inbox (id, event_id, recipient_id, actor_id, event_type, resource_id, summary) VALUES (#{id}, #{eventId}, #{recipientId}, #{actorId}, #{eventType}, #{resourceId}, #{summary})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_inbox WHERE recipient_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_inbox SET read_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{notificationId} AND recipient_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM notification_inbox WHERE id = #{notificationId} AND recipient_id = #{userId})
